neighbours.label: best guess: equative comparisons of feeling or liking ('love X as much as', 'equally puzzled')
fire: If you enjoy baking as much as my sister does, you will love this recipe.
Anyone who loves hiking as much as we do should visit these mountains.
When the results came in, the doctors were equally puzzled by the scans.
I hope you like this little cabin as much as we did last summer.
The parents and the teachers were equally surprised by the decision.
If your kids adore dinosaurs as much as mine, take them to this museum.
Both referees seemed equally confused about what had just happened.
Fans who love jazz as much as I do will find this record a treat.
quiet: If you enjoy baking, my sister has a recipe you will really love.
Anyone who loves hiking should visit these mountains in the autumn.
When the results came in, the doctors were puzzled by the scans.
I hope you like this little cabin; we loved it last summer.
The parents were surprised by the decision, and so were the teachers.
If your kids adore dinosaurs, take them to this museum on a weekday.
Both referees seemed confused about what had just happened.
Fans who love jazz will find this record a real treat.
